notes.title: Stash maintenance downtime for a big update. 9-10am EST
notes.notes:

notes.title: 2017.12.11 - Medallions x100, Rolling Stone Inn, Mob CC, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This is a small but very significant patch due to the x100 of Medallions.

Medallion Changes - x100!

 All accounts had their current medallion totals multiplied by 100.

 All medallion costs for things in game were multiplied by 100.

 The absolute effect of this is no change for players, but it gives us the ability to have things that cost smaller amounts of medallions than what previously would have been 1 medallion. It also gives us the ability to give away medallions as rewards for more things, since we can do so in smaller denominations now.


Bug Fixes:

 Issues loading into the Rolling Stone Inn have been fixed.

 The Newspaper now clears the data on which stalls you have visited each time you close the newspaper.

 Parties no longer follow their leaders into trap encounters.

 Rezzing at the BOO no longer places your character at its last location if you immediately do a character change after rez.

 Fixed a bug that would on rare occasions result in a Mob not being CCed when it should.

 Mobs that are CCed now explicity skip their turn (you will see it in the combat log). So you can more easily verify they are properly staying CCed when they should.

notes.title: 2017.10.12 - 12 New Dungeons, More Newspaper Improvements, Tons of QoL and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Dungeons

 12 new Tier 3 (20-29) Dungeons (RPDs) of 3 distinct types implemented in multiple regions.
 New RPD graphics added to existing RPDs.



Market & Newspaper

 Adds older than 1 week expire.
 Newspapers now "chunk then filter" rather than "filter then chunk" which will make every newspaper have a lot more ads.
 Fixed a bug that did not display an error when you've reached the max number of favorited stalls.
 Newspaper ad stall names now shrink to fit.



Base of Operations

 Removed brick cost and added plank cost to BOO Room Layout change.
 Fixed BOO furniture and upgrades not appearing/refreshing properly.
 Fixed a bug where opening the upgrade Stash popup and then closing it caused the max Stash size to be asymptotic.
 Fixed a bug where stash / shared stash capacity values did not change if viewing a filter not matching an item added.
 Fixed colliders on the level 22 Boo.



Farming / Trapping

 Fixed a tooltip issue when quickly moving the mouse between producers.



Chat and UI

 Fixed a bug where selecting the tell channel via button after talking in another channel made the chat window forget who the last tell was sent to.
 Fixed a bug where creating a new tab displayed all of the chat text without senders.
 Fixed a bug where pressing enter closed the tab options and didn't save/update the settings.



Combat

 Fixed a bug with charge 2.
 Mobs should no longer spawn off-combat grid ( very visible in L shaped encounters)
 Fixed a bug where status effects causing you to not be able to flee combat weren't displaying correctly in error popups.
 Fixed the loot received grab n go chat message display.



Crafting

 Fixed a popup error message when attempting to add an item to a deconstructor that is at maximum capacity.
 Fixed the scroll bar in the recipe book.
 Fixed T2 leather armor to require T2 resources instead of T1 resources



Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Customization/costume changes update to viewers immediately upon character sheet close
 Cleave fixed to properly hit adjacent mobs only, where adjacent is defined as "to the left, right, above, or below" the target (diagonal no longer considered as "next to" target)
 Healer AoE CCs area of effect reduced.
 Lion Kick cooldown reduced.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Upon selecting "Send Tell" in the Social window, the window now closes as to not block the chat window.
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't inspect characters from chat if they weren't in the area.
 Character portraits are no longer retaken when the party status is updated.
 Fixed a bug causing the full difficulty list to not display in the party window.
 Increased the maximum clan rank name length to 13 (from 8) characters.



Gear and Items

 You can now drop reward items on bag slots.
 Buff potion durations increased from 1800 to 3600.
 Fixed several BOO items and machines to take up the correct amount of space when placed



Mobs and NPCs

 Bug fixed that caused mobs to sometimes spawn off the grid.


 
World

 Fixed a bug causing mobs to spawn in hills.



Medallion Shop

 Fixed a bug causing item previews in the medallion shop to not work	



Misc

 General improvements to reduce memory use and increase performance.
 Fixed a couple bugs with character portraits solo and in parties.
 Improved memory performance in the Stash window.
 Fixed a bug where the Founder's Cloak buff got multiplied when casting buffs on yourself
 Staff chat icon changed from a green star to a green lilypad (Frogdice!).

notes.notes:

 Shared Stash! All accounts now start off with 1 slot of shared stash space and it can be upgraded with medallions. You access it via a button at the bottom of your normal stash that says "Switch to Shared Stash."
 Fixed a bug where withdrawing items from the Stash didn't update the capacity label.
 Fixed a bug where dropping items on the trash in your Stash did not give an confirmation popup.



Crafting

 Fixed level 10 soft cloth shoulder cloth requirement to be T2 instead of T1
 Various maker recipes updated and fixed.

 3 members = +80%
 4 members = +120%
 5 members = +160%
 6 members = +220%



Gathering

 World Map Resource Nodes Tripled for the weekend



Medallion Shop

 Add Additional Crafting Skill item now available.



Misc

 Various other bug fixes!

notes.title: UPDATE: Crafting, Inventory management, Resource spawns, Healer buffs, and more! (2017/07/07)
notes.notes:
Crafting

 =====> For many of the fixes below, you will need to pick up/place back down your various crafting machines, producers, farms, gardens, orchards, etc. You will also need to plant new seeds.
 Fixed a number of bugs with farming and harvesting. Orchards and gardens should now properly produce goods and be harvestable for seeds/resources (as long as the contents haven't died yet).
 Orchards, gardens, coops and barns now hold the correct number of seeds and animals, and they now also hold the correct number of items produced. (10 as opposed to 3.)
 Fixed a bug with the UI display of crafting machines above tier 1.
 Fixed a bug where selecting craft for an item didn't update the crafting display.
 The last recipe crafted now gets selected after retrieving an item from the machine inventory.
 Despawn time for resource nodes reduced from ~1 hour to ~30 minutes. Respawn time is the same (they basically respawn instantly as soon as one is harvested).
 Dough recipe has been changed to require 1 egg unit and 1 flour unit. 
 Lard will no longer be dropping in the game, making any lard you have super rare and special! ːsheepieː
 Grain processors have been added to the game, and you may now make flour by growing wheat in your gardens.
 Players must be of the appropriate crafting skill to utilize a tool within their stash.
 Players must be of the appropriate crafting skill level to use machines.



Chat and UI

 Fixed the chat link confirmation background to fit the text.



BOO, Stash, and Market Stalls

 Changed the Stash dropdown filter to match the inventory filter.



Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Healer
 Mesmerize I (level 3) duration increased from 1-3 rounds to 3-5 rounds.
 Root I (level 7) duration increased from 1-3 rounds to 3-5 rounds.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Social Panel now auto-capitalizes character names in the list.



Gear and Items

 Inventory filters improved - especially for crafting/resources. Fixed items missing for various filters in the inventory.
 Fixed a bug where using items didn't update the individual bags.
 Added Minimum Skill to gathering tool tooltips and base level requirements off of that field in the data.
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't split producible items.
 Magical offhands now dropping in game:
 Mystic Tome -8% mana cost, +12% dmg
 TriOrb      -5% mana cost, +15% dmg
 Skullrox    -2% mana cost, +18% dmg



Gathering

 Resource Node Spawn increased x2.



Medallion Shop

 Fixed a bug where weapons in the medallion shop still only showed as two-handed in the tooltip.



Misc

 Admin accounts are no longer part of leaderboards

notes.title: UPDATE: 2017/07/01 - World Map Resource Nodes Doubled, New Bag/Inventory Management with Filters!
notes.notes:
Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Fixed a bug where some of the nameplate parts didn't update when other players changed their customization options (like their title).



Chat and UI

 Fixed an xp bar issue with rounding.


 
Combat

 Fixed a bug causing the hotbar to lock up.



Crafting

 Doubled the number of resource nodes on the overworld map
 Fixed a couple issues in the Recipe Book when you don't have any crafts learned.
 Fixed the total recipe label to reflect recipe counts for whatever the dropdown is set to.

 
 
Characters, Classes, and Abilities

  New Leaderboard rewards added for #1 and #2-10 positions.


 
Gear and Items

 Crafting and Gathering Tools now have their trade skill in the tooltip.
 Fixed a bug where replacing bags didn't update properly.
 Fixed a bug where clicking "No" to replace a bag didn't move the bag item into said bag.
 Recipe item names are now italicized based on your trade skill instead of your character level.
 Recipes that you can't use now tell give that reason in their tooltip.
 The dropdown menu when viewing your inventory no longer has bags, but instead has filters. You can deselect bags to view all bags together or select multiple bags.
 Fixed a bug allowing you to use multiple items at once.
 Fixed a bug where changing gear/costumes in the character sheet didn't update the player portrait.
 Fixed a bug with the selection of multiple items.
 Fixed a bug where reordering items didn't save on the client until you closed and reopen your inventory.
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't remove items from rewards while viewing multiple bags.
 Fixed a bug where double clicking items in your inventory while viewing multiple bags didn't move them to your Stash.
 Fixed a bug where double clicking items in your Stash while viewing multiple bags didn't move them to your inventory.
 Fixed a bug where right clicking and selecting add/withdraw to/from your Stash while viewing multiple bags didn't move items.

 

World

 Fixed a bug where all POIs were coming in invisible to everyone.
 Disabled the grid overlay in the main world view to be consistent with dungeons.
 Re-enabled the world grid.


 
Settings

 Removed the "Movement Queue On" and "Display Grid" toggles from General Settings because they didn't actually do anything.


 
Misc

 Removed warning log messages from the output_log.txt file to improve performance in after playing for an extended amount of time.
 Fixed a bug when other players change their title, they go invisible.
 Various small performance improvements.

notes.title: UPDATE: 2017/06/23 - Elementalist and Gathering buffs, tons of fixes and UI improvements
notes.notes:
A lot of good stuff in this update!

Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 ːrpokkaː Elementalist ːrpokkaː 
 All tier 1 spells (Fire Blast, Zap, Ice Blast, and Pelt) had their range increased from 4 to 5.
 Ice Knife (tier 2 water spell) has a different bonus effect when used on a foe that is chilled. Instead of additional damage, it will root the foe for 2-3 rounds. Chill can be applied with Ice Blast or Hunter's Frost Arrow. 



Gathering

 You will receive an additional +1 resource when harvesting a node in combat while there are mobs still alive.



Mobs and NPCs

 Mobs lose their low level damage output reduction more gradually. Previously, mobs level 1-10 had their damage reduced by 50%, and returned to normal at 11. Now the damage reduction is gradually removed from 11-15 (40%, 30%, 20%, 10%, then normal damage at 15).



World

 Improved the functionality of Click-to-Move, enabling a smoother experience.
 Fixed a significant performance drop that would worsen the longer you ran the client in the open world.



Chat and UI

 New error popup messages for failed logins.
 Fixed a bug causing the chat window to not show the color wheel for selecting text colors.
 Fixed a bug where you could not reorder tabs (and have them save).
 Fixed an issue causing double chat logs when chat messages come in while zoning.
 Fixed a bug where multiple camp materials would stack in the camp window the first time you dropped down the category.
 The tooltip for the xp bar now rounds down so that no one is confused about the percent reaching 100 when they still have some experience to go (mostly seen at higher levels).



BOO, Stash, and Market Stalls

 Fixed a bug where double-clicking a sold item in your Stall didn't collect it.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Clans: Fixed a bug where Promote and Demote didn't do anything.



Gear and Items

 Fixed a but where swapping bags updated the bags but not the inventory displayed.
 Fixed a bug where replacing a bag displayed the new bag in a different slot that it actually was.
 The popup to split an item stack now selects one of the inputs immediately and pressing enter will finalize the action.
 Food and Potion tooltips now have Quality.



Settings

 Fixed a bug where a number of settings weren't getting saved on exit.



Misc

 Moved the [Play] button under the selected character in Character Selection.
 Various sound effect improvements.

notes.title: UPDATE: 2017/03/23 - Bug fixes and preparation for weekend event!
notes.notes:
This update was not originally planned, but there were a few bug fixes we really wanted to get in before the weekend event so we pushed it live.

NOTE: There may be some issues with windows overlaying strangely or text bleeding through from windows behind. This is part of a conversion of UI elements that is not finished yet.

Other noteworthy things about this update:


 Smart pathfinding! You will no longer receive a zone prompt when walking over a PoI unless the PoI is your final destination. This should be especially nice when moving around your BOO.

 Numerous camera angle issues improved to make it behave in a more friendly manner when exiting encounters, going into passive encounters, and similar things.

 Major party chat bug fixed in combat that was messing up combat in parties. This was the main bug that we really wanted fixed before this weekend.


See you for the event and party this weekend!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/466660/discussions/0/133260492053857188/
